prompt: An old medieval quarter by the river and a newer art deco quarter on the hill.

card.name: Two Quarters on the River and Hill

site.text: An old quarter on the riverbank and a newer quarter on the hill above it, two districts linked by streets and stairs.

style.text: Old quarter: medieval timber, stone and thatch. New quarter: art deco, with geometric symmetry, stepped setbacks, gold and black accents, quartz and polished stone, and lantern/sea lantern lighting.

purpose.text: A mixed town where people live, trade and gather, with the old quarter as the working riverside and the new quarter as the civic and residential district.

card.interpretation: You described two districts: an old medieval quarter by the river and a newer art deco quarter on the hill. I read the site as one town split across riverbank and hillside, sized M, using existing land. The style is deliberately two looks, medieval below and art deco above. Purpose is a mixed market town: working riverside below, civic and residential above. The program has about 10 buildings, with a town hall and a deco tower as landmarks.

contradictions.issue: Two different styles in one settlement (medieval and art deco).
contradictions.resolution: Kept both: medieval for the riverside quarter, art deco for the hill quarter, joined by stairs and streets. Style template left null.

assumptions: Terrain: existing land with a river and a hill is used; nothing is sculpted.
Purpose taken as a mixed market town since none was given.
Both a river and a hill are needed nearby; the search will look for them.

program.notes: Medieval timber-framed guild hall at the heart of the old quarter, facing the river.
Stepped setback tower with gold trim and quartz, crowning the hill and visible from the old quarter.
Timber and thatch homes in the old quarter, closely packed along lanes.
Old quarter inn with a terrace over the water.
Stone and timber store by the river for goods.
Medieval forge in the old quarter.
Small medieval stone chapel with bell turret.
Symmetrical multi-storey flats with setbacks, black and gold accents, on the hill.
Stylish storefronts with geometric facades and glowing signage on the hill street.
Marquee-fronted entertainment hall with vertical fins and sea lantern lighting.
